findings.scope: main.cpp folded non-GEMV dispatch, outside GEMV kernels
findings.description: prepare_site forced implementation=1 for folded route+gather, blocking round2 dispatch
findings.resolution: Fixed by owning smallgemv agent: folded route uses dispatch.fusion_choice(route+gather), round2 maps to implementation 2; combined normalization retains 1.

identity_arguments.fp32_input: preparation bitcasts uint32_t(BF16)<<16 without arithmetic; candidate loads that exact float and keeps per-lane eight-product ordering plus split tree
identity_arguments.packed64: IQ4 owner lane & ~2 shares the same eight packed bytes between lower and upper nibble lanes; each lane uses its original scale and nibble shift; expanded formats reinterpret the same eight signed codes without reordering products
identity_arguments.rows2sg: each physical half subgroup emulates all original 32 logical lanes using two accumulators; widths 1,2,4,8 reduce each virtual half and width16 is the final addition; skipping the absent third tile of high lanes removes no products/additions
identity_arguments.runtime_lifetime: prepare-cache key is allocation plus element count; scheduled output writes and token lookup invalidate it; Device::compute orders preparation before consumers; scratch lives in arena until teardown
identity_arguments.cpu_row_scheduling: OpenMP distributes whole independent rows only; every row retains its own complete products, reduction tree and BF16 conversion. GDN retains serial token recurrence inside each state row. Both pragmas are in OWN_RT_HOST_ONLY code.

race_arguments: one output writer per matrix row/projection
each local-memory split partial slot has a unique subgroup leader, followed by an unconditional workgroup barrier
rows2sg private decode has no subgroup collective in divergent half activity branch; all lanes participate in later shuffles
routing status has exactly row-zero leader per slot; alias validation rejects overlapping writable bindings
FP32 preparation has one work item per float; no device-host copy per kernel

GEMV CPU route/status writes precede the parallel row loop; immutable shared weights/input and unique (slot,row,projection) output offsets prevent row races. Each region joins before the next route slot.
GDN CPU row g exclusively owns state [128*g,128*g+128) and outputs r*6144+g; query/key/gates/weights are read-only and guards precede the region. All arrays and accumulators are iteration-local.
interpreter_audit: format and candidate dispatch happen on host; device T/Variant are compile-time; by-value pointer/geometry struct does not interpret descriptors or type-switch within row loops
limits: Source review is not device proof; K1 fresh-owner exactness and K2 timing still required.
Nonfinite GEMV weights/activations remain explicitly unqualified; finite fixture modes do not establish NaN payload/sign identity.

supporting_unsealed_check.result: 36/36 temporary direct finite cases exact plus g++ host and icpx SYCL syntax checks
supporting_unsealed_check.retention: temporary probe source/binary removed; not a sealed gate count; retained fixture gates are authority

timing_harness_review.host_alignment: 64-byte aligned new/delete use matching forms and do not affect numerical values
timing_harness_review.device_readback: K1 checks every run; K2 reads and compares outputs at repetitions 0 and 199, explicitly recorded as first-and-last-repetition; no output readback between those iterations
timing_harness_review.preparation_cost: FP32 preparation first event is included with GEMV events and stage_count; it is not removed from timing
timing_harness_review.limits: Unchecked middle K2 repeats are not individually byte-validated; first/last exactness plus separate K1 are the documented boundary.

memory_accounting_review: 174080 * sizeof(float) = 696320 bytes added to each card base, matching the per-card prepared-fp32-input allocation; no cross-card undercount.
